title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Look-Back Standard for the Hardship Payment Record
content:
**Look-back standard.** For a hardship deferral on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan), the span the payment record is read over follows the account's history: an account granted an earlier deferral reads its record over the whole calendar months from the latest earlier deferral's grant date to the grant date less the months that deferral covered; an account with no earlier deferral funded fewer than twelve whole months before the grant reads it over the whole months since funding plus one; every other account reads it over the 12 months before the grant. When the span so counted is zero months or less, no payment falls inside it and the payment record is zero.

## Span by account history

| Account history at the grant | Span the payment record is read over (months back from the grant date) |
|---|---|
| An earlier deferral booked | Whole calendar months from the latest earlier deferral's grant date to this grant date, less the months that deferral covered |
| No earlier deferral; funded fewer than 12 whole months before the grant | Whole months since funding, plus one |
| No earlier deferral; funded 12 whole months or more before the grant | 12 |
| Span counted as zero months or less | No payment falls inside it; the payment record is zero |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical accounts, no earlier deferral)

| Whole months since funding | Span |
|---|---|
| 7 | 8 |
| 11 | 12 |
| 12 | 12 |
| 30 | 12 |

## Cases with an earlier deferral (hypothetical)

- The latest earlier deferral was granted 21 whole calendar months before this grant and covered 2 months: the span is 21 less 2, or 19 months.
- The latest earlier deferral was granted 2 whole calendar months before this grant and covered 3 months: 2 less 3 is below zero, so no payment falls inside the span and the payment record is zero.
